description: Read one published mobile plan, home internet offer, current account, credit card, personal loan, electricity, gas or dual offer, with numeric fees, capabilities, eligibility, sources and canonical website URL. Mobile includes monthly fee and allowance timelines and separate one-off costs. Null means unknown. For home internet, reuse search filters in connection to preserve technology and same-profile speeds; address availability is not checked. For home internet and banking only, optional price_id confirms ALL conditions of exactly one returned selectable price option; never infer customer qualification. Reuse search amount/term in loan or consumption in energy to preserve listing values. Energy estimates include returned household/location assumptions, not address availability. Loan examples are not personalized quotes. Source terms may remain Italian.

connection.description: Home internet only. Reuse the search connection filters to preserve the same connection in details, comparison and website links. Both speeds must match one published profile; address availability is not checked.

profile_id.description: Exact published profile_id. Required when connection filters do not identify a single profile for a profile-specific price.

energy.description: Energy only. Reuse search consumption to retain the same monthly estimate. No address availability check.

annual_kwh.description: Annual electricity consumption. Website default: 2700 kWh.

annual_smc.description: Annual gas consumption. Website default: 1400 Smc.

loan.description: Personal loans only. Reuse the search amount and term; examples are not personalized quotes.

locale.description: Website link language; source terms may remain Italian.

price_id.description: Home internet and banking only: confirmation of ALL conditions on one returned selectable price option. Mobile uses terms, not price_id. Never infer qualification.

name: get_product
